method.surface: authenticated live WOW List page feed in page-owner view
method.procedure: Repeated lazy scrolling from the page top to a stable terminal document height; dated cards were deduplicated by rendered date, normalized body, shared-source label, posted URLs, and media identity.
method.completenessDefinition: One hundred percent means every distinct post exposed by the authenticated live page feed on the capture date received a public-safe ledger row.
limitations: This is not a native Meta export or proof of complete lifetime account history.
Deleted, hidden, private, unpublished, or no-longer-retained posts can remain outside the recovered population.
Meta Business Suite's displayed Lifetime filter covered only March 31, 2019 through July 14, 2026 and returned no posts, so it cannot account for the 2015-2018 live-feed population.
A shared-source label identifies the public source card Facebook displayed; it does not identify the human author of the WOW List page post.
Jamie's memory that he managed the project's social presence remains a research lead pending collaborator confirmation or native account audit data.
method.privacy: Raw post bodies, comments, reaction identities, follower identities, contact details, authenticated URLs, tracking parameters, and session data are excluded.

displayedInteractionSummary.boundary: Capture-date interface counts are volatile and are not reach, attendance, conversion, endorsement, unique people, mandate, or impact.
